alt: A short film with no voice. A deep blue room with a window. A small amber block figure with white eyes looks down at a phone standing on the floor. A sign in the window flips from MON to TUE, WED and THU, and the figure shrinks a little each day, eyes wide. At last a speech bubble that says yes! pops up over the phone and the figure pulses with happy eyes. The text stays: i read it, i'll reply later, later: 3 days.
